learning_outcomes.text: Explain the structure and components of mechatronic systems in vehicles.
Evaluate various sensors and actuators for a given application.
Describe the characteristics of microcontrollers as part of a control unit.
Create small programs to demonstrate typical basic functions of a microcontroller.
Create a state diagram for a given process.
Compare the characteristics and advantages/disadvantages of different bus systems.
Describe the procedures for manufacturer-specific vehicle diagnostics and OBD.
Apply learned methods to similar mechatronics problems.
Solve more complex tasks, including in small groups, and communicate and explain technical content.
Independently and collaboratively delve into topics and discuss them competently.

syllabus_topics: Functional representation by sensors, actuators, and control units
Application of vehicle mechatronics in vehicle dynamics control, in the powertrain, in driver assistance systems
Examples of actuators from automotive engineering
Use of microcontrollers in control units
Bus systems in the vehicle: LIN
Bus systems in the vehicle: CAN
Bus systems in the vehicle: MOST
Bus systems in the vehicle: FlexRay
Bus systems in the vehicle: Automotive Ethernet
